principle: Annotations describe observable objects or attributes; violations are rule-engine outputs.
unknown_policy: Do not force a class when the object or attribute is not visually observable; record the review state as unknown or uncertain. UNKNOWN and UNCERTAIN are review states, not detector labels.

notes.car: Includes sedans, SUVs, and crossovers. SUV/crossover is not a separate detector class.
notes.van: Only visual van detector class. UV Express / public-for-hire operation is contextual metadata, not a YOLO class. Plate appearance alone is not conclusive authorization.
notes.autorickshaw: Integrated three-wheel passenger/cargo body. Distinct from conventional motorcycle-with-sidecar tricycle and from motorcycle. Piaggio is brand metadata, not a detector class.
notes.pickup_truck: Separate detector class from truck. Applicable to Unauthorized Passenger in Applicable Truck/Pickup Cargo Area. Not automatically included in truck-ban applicability.
notes.broad_categories: Hierarchy keys are derived broad classes for rule applicability; they are not detector labels.
notes.legacy_labels: suv and suv_crossover normalize to car; uv_express_van normalizes to van. Ambiguous legacy piaggio must not auto-map; requires body-form review (tricycle vs autorickshaw) or UNCERTAIN.
